title: Streaming Retries, Truncation and Metering
instructions: Implement `StreamInterrupted`, `TokenBudget`, `stream_with_retry` and `metered_stream` in `llm_stream.py` (`llm_retry.py` is provided). Retry only while no chunk has reached the consumer, otherwise raise `StreamInterrupted` with the partial text. Reserve tokens synchronously, always settle actual usage in a `finally` (early break, error or cancellation), and close upstream generators with `contextlib.aclosing`.

evidence.label: Retries a failure that happens before any token is delivered
A failure after the first token raises StreamInterrupted with the partial text, chained from the cause
Non-retryable errors propagate unchanged after one attempt
Respects max_attempts and refuses to retry a Retry-After above max_retry_after
Consumer break closes the upstream stream immediately
reserve is synchronous, rejects over-limit requests untouched; settle records actual usage
metered_stream settles actual usage and closes the upstream on early exit
An over-budget stream is rejected before the upstream is touched
A cancelled consumer still releases its reservation
With 20 concurrent consumers exactly 10 fit the budget and the totals stay consistent
